title: colored-noise / per-frequency SNR whitening spectral geometry

whitening_summary.snr_units: linear power SNR; 20 dB reference = snr_f = 100.0
whitening_summary.whitening: C_f = V diag(d) V^H, W_f = V diag(1/sqrt(max(d, tiny))) V^H, tiny = 1e-30
whitening_summary.jitter_rule: add 1e-14 * I to C_f only when cond(C_f) > 1e12 or min eig <= 0
whitening_summary.whitened_complex_blocks: A_w = W_f A_c, B_w = W_f B_c
whitening_summary.realification: A_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(A_w); Im(A_w)], B_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(B_w); Im(B_w)] via hh.whiten_realify(A_w, B_w, None)
whitening_summary.multi_frequency_stack: vertical [real whitened blocks for each frequency]

environment_note: Apple Silicon CPU, no GPU/MPS/CUDA; deterministic dense numpy/scipy linear algebra except fixed-seed Monte Carlo

config.pose_theta_convention: theta = atan2(-p_y, -p_x): body +x axis points toward the origin

smooth_basis.note: identical construction/config to family2, family3, family4

noise_model.snr_units: linear power SNR; 20 dB reference = snr_f = 100.0
noise_model.whitening: C_f = V diag(d) V^H, W_f = V diag(1/sqrt(max(d, tiny))) V^H, tiny = 1e-30
noise_model.jitter_rule: add 1e-14 * I to C_f only when cond(C_f) > 1e12 or min eig <= 0
noise_model.whitened_complex_blocks: A_w = W_f A_c, B_w = W_f B_c
noise_model.realification: A_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(A_w); Im(A_w)], B_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(B_w); Im(B_w)] via hh.whiten_realify(A_w, B_w, None)
noise_model.multi_frequency_stack: vertical [real whitened blocks for each frequency]

monte_carlo.draw_formula: g = standard_normal((n, m_c, 2)) @ [1, 1j] / sqrt(2); z = V sqrt(d) g; y = W_f z; r = sqrt(2)*[Re y; Im y]
monte_carlo.scale_note: The 1/sqrt(2) factor makes g a proper CN(0,I) draw under the model covariance convention E[g g^H] = I (Re and Im each have variance 1/2), so realified whitened noise has covariance I. An unscaled draw (Re, Im ~ N(0,1)) would have covariance 2*C_f.

config.randomness_note: deterministic dense linear algebra; Monte Carlo whitening sanity check uses fixed numpy default_rng seeds {2718, 4242, 5150}

A_whitening_sanity.note: Monte Carlo reports a statistical residual against identity, expected O(sqrt(2/n)) per diagonal entry; it is recorded, not used as a machine-precision gate.

kernel_identity.note: N1 = {u: K_SLAM u = 0}, N2 = null(P_perp A) = {u: A u in Range(B)}; both two-sided residual orientations of Family 2 c1 are reported together with the requested own-null residuals.

C_snr_sweep.directions_selected_from: three smallest ascending generalized eigenvalues of K_SLAM_1 w.r.t. K_IS_1; parameter directions u = V_A diag(1/s_A) w (Family-2/4 audit convention)

D_duplicate_invariance.note: The duplicate uses the identical whitened block twice (same C_f and W_f).  No-prior K_IS/K_SLAM and retention are expected invariant under the (1+c^2) scale; the fixed finite prior is expected to break the rho invariance (recorded, not a failure).

E_receiver_correlation.note: Recorded without a forced pass.  Absolute Frobenius distances mix the sigma_f scale with receiver decorrelation; rho/angles/masses are the scale-free geometry comparisons.

linear_algebra_scope_note: Finite-dimensional colored-whitened/realified dense linear algebra on the validated Family-1 Jacobians with a declared synthetic per-frequency covariance; no continuum-limit, estimator, or recovery claims.
